scope: Command support and composition package placement; research only

observed_layout.command_support: cmd/internal/command owns config flags, parse/load, signals and process exit; no application dispatch modes.
observed_layout.core_composition: cmd/internal/wiring.Open constructs the SQLite adapter and services.Application, initializes it, and returns once-only cleanup. Each main separately selects transports/lifecycle hooks.
observed_layout.note: internal/ports/bootstrap_boundaries_test.go mentions the command path as an AST-audit fixture; it does not import that package. An old services-port comment still says composed by bootstrap, but actual wiring lives under cmd/internal.

import_examples.allowed: would be allowed by internal visibility if composition were moved there; architectural guards still needed to forbid the dependency, subject to import-cycle checks
